subject: Quick technical probe before demo - BrightCart
messages:
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha@brightcart.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick technical screen before full demo?

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick onboarding flow — we signed up through the self-serve trial and our product team would like to do a short technical check before scheduling the full product demo. We want to confirm simple compatibility (VPC egress, token limits, and expected latency for short chat interactions).

Can we do a 15-minute call today or tomorrow? Prefer earlier in the day PST.

A little context: we’re BrightCart (e-commerce headless platform), evaluating Redwood for checkout recommendation generation and a few reranking endpoints. We have a staging VPC and can share a sanitized request example if helpful.

Thanks,
Ayesha Khan
Senior Product Manager, BrightCart
ayesha@brightcart.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: brightcart-sample-request.txt (text stub)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick technical screen before full demo?

Hi Ayesha — thanks for signing up and for the context. 15 minutes works well. I’m copying Ben (solutions) and Sean (your AM) so we can make sure the call covers the right technical checklist.

Available windows (PST):
- Today 11:30–11:45
- Today 15:00–15:15
- Tomorrow 09:00–09:15

If you can pick one slot that works for your team I’ll send a calendar invite. If you can attach the sanitized request example (or the path to where you uploaded it) that’ll help us prep.

Quick ask for the call:
- Confirm primary use case (rerank vs generate)
- Whether you need private VPC connectivity or just public API from staging
- Approx QPS and typical input sizes (tokens)

Thanks — I’ll hold the slots until I hear back.

Best,
Rachel Kim
SDR, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
Attachment: placeholder-invite.ics (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ayesha Khan <ayesha@brightcart.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick technical screen before full demo?

Looping in a quick checklist — happy to take the 15-min. I can do today 11:30 or tomorrow 09:00 (PST). If we take the earlier today slot I’ll plan to cover:

- Expected request/response size (example payload)
- Auth patterns (API key vs short-term tokens/VPC)
- Any red flags: large context windows, streaming, or webhooks that require special network config

If BrightCart can drop a sanitized request and a short note about traffic (peak/min QPS), we’ll be able to give tighter guidance on config and an initial perf estimate.

Also fine if you prefer to have Sean join for the commercial context only. I’ll keep the call focused and bring a one-slide architecture sketch if needed.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachment: be-prepared-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha@brightcart.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick technical screen before full demo?

Thanks Rachel — we’ll take the tomorrow 09:00 PST slot. Attaching a very small sanitized network sketch and a sample request (both tiny). Mostly we want to confirm whether we should pursue a hosted API path or if we need one of your private options for security.

Agenda for the 15m:
- 3m: BrightCart quick intro + primary goal
- 7m: Ben to confirm compatibility and any blockers
- 5m: Next steps and scheduling the full demo

I attached: brightcart-arch-sketch.png and brightcart-sample-request.txt (sanitized).

See you tomorrow — Ayesha
